mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event ( event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_type, topic_name, message_key, payload_json ) VALUES ( #{event.eventId}, #{event.eventType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.topicName}, #{event.messageKey}, #{event.payloadJson} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY available_at, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND( (status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= NOW(3)) )
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, available_at = #{availableAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
